1_support_reaction.note: Equal triad; horizontal components cancel for symmetric vertical load.

2_boss_face_crush_spacer.formula: sigma = F_pre / A, A = pi/4 (OD^2 - ID^2) of metal spacer contact annulus
2_boss_face_crush_spacer.layer_direction: boss face is perpendicular to the horizontal screw axis, i.e. a vertical plane; the compressive load runs along the axis, parallel to layer planes (in-plane direction)
2_boss_face_crush_spacer.note: Largest preload-dependent stress; preload is not defined, so this sets a preload ceiling.

3_screw_pullout_shear.layer_direction: shear surface is cylindrical about screw axis (horizontal); layer planes cut it, so shear crosses layer interfaces on the thread flank
3_screw_pullout_shear.note: Pull-out in an 8 mm long boss is governed by layer shear if the thread crosses layers; thread-form stress not computed.

4_ball_side_web_bending.formula: sigma = 6 M / (b t^2), M = N L/2 (uniform) or N L (tip)
4_ball_side_web_bending.layer_direction: bending stress acts along the screw/bearing axis (horizontal), i.e. in the layer plane; the web normal has a vertical component cos(61)=0.485 so layer interfaces cut the web thickness at an angle

line_count.note: web thickness in 0.4 mm lines; 3 vs 4 perimeter setting does not add lines to this web

5_boss_root_bending.formula: sigma = M/Z, Z = pi(Ro^4-Ri^4)/(4Ro); tau = V/A (vertical component only)
5_boss_root_bending.layer_direction: bending stress is along the boss axis (horizontal, in layer plane); interlayer shear is the vertical component only
5_boss_root_bending.note: Root bending is low; not governing under these assumptions.

7_not_computed.screw_thread_radial_stress_in_pilot: no fit/thread model; test coupon required
7_not_computed.layer_normal_tension_in_web: needs web normal stress from fit model; test required
7_not_computed.creep_fatigue_temperature: no service temperature or life target

print.orientation: print Z = source Z; bearing/screw axes horizontal (tilt 0)
print.temperature: 200-210 C nozzle / 50-60 C bed per PRINT.md (unverified profile)

assumptions: Ball press force: 5 / 10 / 20 N downward on ball, ASSUMED (no user load defined in repo). Sensitivity only.
Screw preload 30 / 50 / 100 N, ASSUMED (no torque or preload measurement).
PLA strengths in REF are provisional placeholders, not same-condition test data; per doc they are comparison values only.
Bearing reaction taken as vertical-load equal triad: each support reaction = share * F (verified in verification.json).

Web model: thin cantilever of thickness t_min, neck width b where t<=t_min+0.4 mm (one nozzle line), fixed at shell end, load N distributed over L_eng. Crude; real web is curved and partly supported by the boss. Not FEM.
Boss root model: annular cantilever (R_out 3.5, bore 1.075), point load N at boss height 2.5 mm. Crude.
Thread stress from screw-pilot interference is NOT computed: no thread-form or fit data. Requires coupon test.
Drop/handling loads: NOT computed (no impact energy or height defined).
Temperature and creep: NOT evaluated (no service temperature or life target defined).
verdict_reasons: Printer model, PLA product and lot, drying, and profile version are not fixed (doc requires them).
No user load is defined; all loads here are assumptions. Finger press is assumed 5/10/20 N.
No same-condition allowable exists; the PLA strengths used are provisional placeholders, so only comparisons are valid.
Ball-side web is 1.84 mm (target 1.6, floor 1.2). Under the provisional crude model SF 2 holds only up to a ball press of about 27.4 N.
Boss-face crush under metal spacer is high at 50-100 N preload; preload not defined.
Boss root bending and screw shear are low under the assumed loads, not governing.
No physical print, fit, or drop/cycle test has been done.
governing_failure_mode: ball-side web bending (thin neck between pilot bore and ball void), with boss-face crush as a preload ceiling
